what: The product photo grid (a plain grid before sorting — vertical scroll inside the panel) flies in 1s cubic-bezier(.42,0,.21,1) each time the score (data-score) changes (fx:sort) and settles by rank: three large center spots (panel 35% width, two + one below) · inner ring (panel 1.25x, 44% of the rest) · outer ring (1.6x, the remainder) — each product gets a single translate + scale (relative to the largest spot’s width, transform-origin 0 0), so size changes along with position. The center panel is a square of 62.67vw (phone 100vw). After the first sort, you drag the whole panel to look around — beyond the edge it follows only 10%, and on release it slides with inertia (power .35 · timeConstant 300ms) and bounces at the edge (bounceStiffness 300 · bounceDamping 35, motion’s inertia). The wheel pushes it directly by that amount. When the layout changes, the panel returns inside the edge in .6s cubic-bezier(.42,0,.21,1). Moving the cursor stretches the screen width·height by ±10px and pushes the panel the opposite way, with the center following in 1s · inner ring 1.75s · outer ring 2.5s (cubic-bezier(.075,.82,.165,1)), so the farther out, the later it flows.

options.[data-fx-part=wrap]: Grid holding the product cells (dragging moves it via translate)
options.[data-fx-part=item]: A single product cell — inserted by the side that writes data-score (number). When attached, data-rank (from 1) and data-ring (main, first, second) on the box inside
options.[data-fx-part=box] > [data-fx-part=fly]: (create if missing) stagger layer > Flying layer. Cell size is box (the consumer’s css), fly changes to the largest slot size when aligning
options.ratio: Share for the inner circle out of what remains after the center, default .44 (original worldwide version .33)
options.parallax: Max cursor parallax in px, default 10 (0 turns it off)
options.pan-dur · pan-ease: Duration for returning the panel to inside the end .6s · 0.42,0,0.21,1
options.elastic: Share that follows beyond the end, default .1
options.fx:sort · fx:reset: After changing scores, send fx:sort to reseat them. fx:reset returns to the grid
options.[data-nodrag]: Children that should not start a drag (buttons and inputs are excluded automatically)

note: Without motion (@11.18.2 vanilla), it stops with GSAP expo.out instead of inertia. After snapping, the panel is a drag panel, so touch-action: none. A panel covering the full screen height would stop the page from scrolling on phones, so after snapping make the panel a single fixed screen (position: fixed). A press after dragging does not pick a product (100ms)
